FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: LuxeBeauty Essentials operates as a retail cosmetics store specializing in pre-packaged, branded cosmetics and toiletries. Our business is dedicated to providing high-quality beauty products sourced exclusively from FDA-registered manufacturers, ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. We focus on offering a curated selection of skincare, makeup, and personal care items, with an emphasis on natural and organic ingredients that cater to various customer needs. Our retail operations generate annual sales of under $500,000, which allows us to maintain manageable levels of exposure and risk. We do not engage in any on-site manufacturing, blending, or repackaging of products, thus minimizing any potential contamination concerns. Our goal is to deliver exceptional customer service while ensuring a safe shopping environment for all our clients.
